name: Summer Teen Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Volunteer in a Norton hospital over the summer. Each hospital has its own teen application and volunteer manager. The page does not list the tasks.
who_can_apply: Teens ages 14 to 17. Pick a hospital and use its summer teen application.
duration: Not stated. The student program takes less time than the adult program, which asks for 6 months at 2 to 4 hours a week.
deadline_text: No dates are posted. The page says onboarding takes about a month, so apply early and ask the hospital's volunteer manager for dates.
how_to_apply: Choose a Norton hospital. Fill out its Summer Teen form on the Norton volunteer page. Then contact that hospital's volunteer manager.
notes: Norton Audubon, Brownsboro, Hospital, West Louisville, Women's and Children's, and Norton Children's Hospital each list a teen form for ages 14 to 17. Norton Women's and Children's also has a school year teen form. Norton Scott lists no teen program. The page says only some hospitals take teen volunteers all year. Openings are limited. The page says hospital volunteers must pass a background check and health screen. It does not say if that applies to teens.
